_**Agent (copilot/claude-haiku-5.5)**_

Added an `overrides` entry to `package.json#L51-L55` so `openapi-typescript` uses the project's TypeScript instead of its declared `^5.x` peer:

```json
"overrides": {
  "openapi-typescript": {
    "typescript": "$typescript"
  }
}
```

`npm install` now succeeds without `--legacy-peer-deps`, and `npm ls` shows a single `typescript@6.0.3` with no peer errors.

This resolves the install error but not the underlying mismatch: `openapi-typescript` is only officially tested against TypeScript 5. I haven't run `npm run openapi` to confirm the generated output still works, since it overwrites `api.model.ts`.
